Shannon McRandle as Mara Jade on the cover of ''Star Wars Insider'' 47 (January 2000). First official flesh-and-blood image of Mara Jade, photographed for Decipher's Star Wars Customizable Card Game.

Fair use of a magazine cover for identification of the SWCCG model on [[Shannon Baksa]].
